name: Living with a vampire
source:
Dave has inhereted an old house from his great grandmother and discovers there is a vampire living in his attic. 

What will Dave do? Will he throw him out, befriend or romance him? You decide!

[From [url=https://dreamsnails.itch.io/living-with-a-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
戴夫从他的曾祖母那里继承了一座老房子，并发现他的阁楼里住着一个吸血鬼。

戴夫会做什么？他会把他赶出去，与他成为朋友还是谈恋爱？你决定！

[来自[url=https://dreamsnails.itch.io/living-with-a-vampire]itch.io[/url]]
